name: Imprisonment
description:
Casting time: 1 minute.

Once per rest: Roll Spirit vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. If you are outside your Sanctum, your roll is ill-favored and the creature's roll is favored.

On a loss, you cannot target the creature with this spell ever again. On a win, you may magically imprison the creature in one of the following ways:

  • Torpor. The creature falls into an unending sleep from which it cannot be awoken.

  • Shrink. You reduce the creature to a height of 1 inch and place it within a small object of your choosing, which becomes unbreakable and un-openable.

  • Bondage. You conjure indestructible bonds which hold the creature in place.

  • Interment. The creature is sealed deep underground in a sphere of force that is warded against magic travel.

  • Confinement. You send the creature to a harmless demiplane, which has a shape of your choosing.

While the effect lasts, the creature doesn't age and doesn't need to eat, drink or breathe. Spells can't locate or perceive the target.

When you cast the spell, you must define an achievable condition that will cause the spell to end and release the target.

You may hold in this way a number of creatures equal to your ranks in Spirit. If you successfully imprison another, the first one you imprisoned is freed.

Describe the imprisonment.
